hate_comment: Hudugir ge driving baralla, road alli bandre accident guarantee.
counter_speech: Driving skill gender mele depend aagalla. Proper practice, road awareness mattu traffic rules paalisidre yaaru aadru safe driver aagbahudu. Bengaluru traffic nalli saaviraaru mahileyaru two-wheeler, cab mattu BMTC bus galannu safely operate maadtiro real examples namma mundide.
english_translation: Driving skill does not depend on gender. With proper practice, road awareness and following traffic rules, anyone can become a safe driver. We have real examples before us of thousands of women safely operating two-wheelers, cabs and BMTC buses in Bengaluru traffic.

hate_comment: Hennu makkalu ge higher studies yaake, madve aadmele mane nodkobeku ashte.
counter_speech: Vidyaabhyasa prathiyobba vyaktiya moola hakku. Higher education padedha mahileyaru financial independence thogothare mattu kutumbakke balavada support aagtaare. Maduve aadro kooda tamma career continue maaduvudhu avara aaykhe aagiratte, adannu naavu respect maadbeku.
english_translation: Education is the fundamental right of every individual. Women with higher education gain financial independence and become strong support for their families. Even after marriage, continuing their career is their choice, and we should respect that.

hate_comment: Girls ge coding antha tough subject ella, boys ge matra sari hogtade.
counter_speech: Programming logic, problem solving mattu practice mele depend aagutte, gender mele alla. World-nalli Ada Lovelace inda shuruvaagi indina tech companies varagu mahila software engineers decisive impact beersiddare. Hard work mattu dedication idre yaaru aadru coding master maadabahudu.
english_translation: Programming depends on logic, problem solving and practice, not gender. From Ada Lovelace to modern tech companies, women software engineers have made a decisive impact. Anyone with hard work and dedication can master coding.

hate_comment: Avalu boss aagidale andre office politics maadi baLsidaale, talent illa.
counter_speech: Ondhu leadership position ge talupalu hard work, competence mattu performance mukhya. Avara talent nodade kevala avalu hennu antha baseless aropane maaduvudu professional culture ge sariyalla. Avara achievements mattu project delivery results nodi judge maadona.
english_translation: Reaching a leadership position requires hard work, competence and performance. Making baseless allegations simply because she is a woman without considering her talent harms professional culture. Let us judge by looking at her achievements and project delivery results.

hate_comment: Hudugi raatri late bandre character sari illa antha artha.
counter_speech: Office shift, education, traffic athava emergencies kaaranadinda late aagabahudu. Timing nodi yaara character judge maaduvudu thappu mattu unfair. Prathi nagarikanigu public space nalli surakshithavaagi sancharisuvudu samvidhanika hakku, adannu naavu support maadbeku.
english_translation: Being late can happen due to work shifts, education, traffic or emergencies. Judging someone's character by the time is wrong and unfair. Every citizen has a constitutional right to move safely in public spaces, and we should support that.

hate_comment: Hennu makkalu cricket aadodu waste, avrige adu match agalla.
counter_speech: Women's cricket world level nalli tumba standard match gallannu deliver maadtiro time idhu. Smriti Mandhana, Harmanpreet Kaur mattu Mithali Raj avara saadhane deshadha abhimana hechiside. Hard work, fitness mattu strategy idre yaava sport aadru excel aagabahudu.
english_translation: Women's cricket delivers world-standard matches today. The achievements of Smriti Mandhana, Harmanpreet Kaur and Mithali Raj have heightened our nation's pride. With hard work, fitness and strategy, anyone can excel in any sport.

hate_comment: Wife job madodu beda, husband duddu sampaadsidre saaku.
counter_speech: Eradu jana kelsa maadidre kutumbada financial security hechhuttade mattu inflation manage maadodu sulabha aagutte. Hennige tanna swanta kanasu mattu identity grow maadoke hakku ide. Kutumbadalli mutual understanding mattu shared responsibilities idre life tumba comfortable aagirutte.
english_translation: When both partners work, the family's financial security increases and managing inflation becomes easier. A woman has the right to grow her own dreams and identity. With mutual understanding and shared responsibilities, life becomes much more comfortable.

hate_comment: Girls ge maths science baralla, arts togoLi saaku.
counter_speech: STEM fields nalli lakhantar hudugiyaru top ranks padedu global level research maadtiro facts namma mundide. Subject aptitude individual interest mattu rigorous training mele depend aagutte. Gender nodi stream restrict maadodu talent waste maadidante aagutte.
english_translation: Facts show that lakhs of girls earn top ranks in STEM fields and conduct global-level research. Subject aptitude depends on individual interest and rigorous training. Restricting academic streams based on gender wastes genuine talent.

hate_comment: Hudugir cooking maadodu avara kartavya, boys ge adu bekilla.
counter_speech: Aduge maaduvudu prathiyobba manushyage thilidhirabekada basic survival life-skill, gender duty alla. Hudugaru kooda cooking kalithukondre independent aagi jeevisabahudu. Mane kelsa ellaru serikond maadidre sneha mattu mutual respect beliyuttade.
english_translation: Cooking is a basic survival life skill that every human should know, not a gender duty. If boys also learn cooking, they can live independently. When everyone shares household chores, affection and mutual respect grow.

hate_comment: Hennu makkalu emotional, so leadership ge fit alla.
counter_speech: Empathy mattu emotional intelligence ondhu successful organization conduct maadalu bahala mukhyavaada gunagalu. Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw mattu Indra Nooyi antha leaders global corporations na lead maadi prove maadiddare. Decision making capacity competence mattu vision mele nirnayavagatte.
english_translation: Empathy and emotional intelligence are crucial qualities for leading a successful organisation. Leaders like Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw and Indra Nooyi have led global corporations and proven this. Decision-making capacity depends on competence and vision.

hate_comment: Pregnant aadre office ge baralla, company ge loss.
counter_speech: Maternity benefit anuvadhu samvidhanika mattu legal protection aagidhe, anukampa alla. Experienced professionals na retain maadkoloke progressive companies maternity support provide maadtave. Long-term loyalty mattu corporate growth ge inclusion tumba valuable aagutte.
english_translation: Maternity benefits are a constitutional and legal protection, not an act of charity. Progressive companies provide maternity support to retain experienced professionals. Inclusion is very valuable for long-term loyalty and corporate growth.

hate_comment: Girls ge bike odisoke baralla, back seat alli kuLthkoLli.
counter_speech: Two-wheeler balance mattu road safety practice inda barutte, gender inda alla. Today thousands of women long-distance rides, touring mattu daily commute bike moolaka easily maadthiddare. Stereotypes bittu avara confidence na encourage maadona.
english_translation: Two-wheeler balance and road safety come through practice, not gender. Today thousands of women easily handle long-distance rides, touring and daily commuting on motorbikes. Let us drop stereotypes and encourage their confidence.

hate_comment: Boys alsta, cry maadbaradu, adu hennu thara.
counter_speech: Aluvudu natural human emotion, adhu weakness lakshana khanditha alla. Feelings express maadadhe suppress maadidre mental health tumba damage aagutte. Hudugaru tamma pain share maadodhu normal mattu healthy antha naavu thilkolbeku.
english_translation: Crying is a natural human emotion, definitely not a sign of weakness. Suppressing feelings without expressing them damages mental health. We must understand that boys sharing their pain is completely normal and healthy.

hate_comment: Hennu police aagidre criminals ge bhaya aagalla.
counter_speech: Law enforcement strict training, discipline, mental strength mattu legal powers mele nillatte. Namma deshadalli mahila IPS officers corrupt networks mattu criminal syndicates na dismantle maadiddaare. Khaki dress ge gender bedha illa, seve mattu duty mukhyavaagide.
english_translation: Law enforcement stands on strict training, discipline, mental strength and legal authority. Women IPS officers in our country have dismantled corrupt networks and criminal syndicates. The police uniform knows no gender; service and duty are what matter.

hate_comment: Mane alli hennu iddre kelsakke sigodu kashta, marriage madkondre kelsa bidthare.
counter_speech: Marriage aadmele kooda careers successfully build maadtiro lakshanthara working women iddhaare. Work-life balance kutumbada support mattu company policies mele depend aagutte. Biased hiring decisions bittu talent mattu merit mele opportunities open irabeku.
english_translation: Lakhs of working women successfully build their careers even after marriage. Work-life balance depends on family support and company policies. Rather than biased hiring decisions, opportunities should remain open based on talent and merit.

hate_comment: Hennu makkalu dress hege haakidre aste anta alla, avrige respect beda.
counter_speech: Dignity mattu bodily autonomy prathiyobba manushyage samvidhana kottiro moola hakku. Dress aaykhe vyaktigatha freedom, adannu mischaracterize maadi disrespect justify maadodu tumba thappu. Respect consent mattu basic humanity mele base aagirabeku.
english_translation: Dignity and bodily autonomy are fundamental rights guaranteed by the constitution to every human being. Choice of clothing is personal freedom; mischaracterising it to justify disrespect is very wrong. Respect must be based on consent and basic humanity.

hate_comment: Girls ge gym alli enu kelsa, avrige weight lift maadoke agalla.
counter_speech: Strength training, bone density improve maadoke mattu overall physical fitness ge workout ellarigu essential. Mirabai Chanu mattu Karnam Malleswari weightlifting nalli Olympic medals geddu deshada hesaru thandiddare. Gym fitness space, yaara exclusive domain alla.
english_translation: Strength training is essential for everyone to improve bone density and overall physical fitness. Mirabai Chanu and Karnam Malleswari won Olympic medals in weightlifting and brought glory to the nation. A gym is a fitness space, nobody's exclusive domain.

hate_comment: Hennu manager kelsa maadidre team ge nimmadi iralla, hudugru adjust aagalla.
counter_speech: Professional workplace nalli managerial effectiveness clear communication, strategic vision mattu fair leadership mele determine aagutte. Female leaders collaborative team environments create maadodralli excellent track record thorsidhaare. Stereotypes bittu collaborative spirit inda kelsa maadona.
english_translation: In a professional workplace, managerial effectiveness is determined by clear communication, strategic vision and fair leadership. Female leaders have shown an excellent track record in creating collaborative team environments. Let us drop stereotypes and work in a collaborative spirit.

hate_comment: Hennu makkalu duddu savari tolsi spend maadthare, savings gottilla.
counter_speech: Self-help groups, microfinance success mattu domestic financial management nalli mahileyara financial discipline prove aagidhe. Investment decisions personal literacy mattu planning mele depend aagutte. Negative generalizations bittu realistic financial contribution na recognize maadbeku.
english_translation: Women's financial discipline has been proven in self-help groups, microfinance success and domestic financial management. Investment decisions depend on personal literacy and planning. We should drop negative generalizations and recognize realistic financial contributions.

hate_comment: Hudugi single aagidre problem ide, madve aagi settle aagbeku.
counter_speech: Single aagi iruvudhu vyaktiya swanta personal choice mattu life autonomy. Prathiyobbara jeevanada priorities, goals mattu timing bere bere aagirutte. Maduve matra settlement standard alla, self-fulfillment mattu happiness kooda samana pramukhya paadithave.
english_translation: Being single is an individual's personal choice and personal autonomy. Every person's life priorities, goals and timing are different. Marriage is not the only standard of settlement; self-fulfilment and happiness hold equal importance.

hate_comment: Hennu makkalu night shifts kelsa maadidre safe alla, barodu beda.
counter_speech: Night shift safety workplace compliance, CCTV, verified transport mattu strict policing moolaka ensure aagabeku. Safety reasons heLi mahileyara economic opportunities cut maaduvudu progress ge addi. Secure infrastructure create maadodhu administration mattu employer javabdaari.
english_translation: Night shift safety must be ensured through workplace compliance, CCTV, verified transport and strict policing. Curtailing women's economic opportunities citing safety issues hinders progress. Creating secure infrastructure is the responsibility of employers and the administration.

hate_comment: Girls ge sports alli stamina illa, sumne time pass.
counter_speech: Endurance training mattu rigorous diet ninda stamina build aagutte. PV Sindhu badminton marathon matches nalli torisiro stamina world-class aagidhe. Hard work inda build aago physical capability na casual aagi dismiss maadodu sports spirit ge viruddha.
english_translation: Stamina is built through endurance training and a rigorous diet. The stamina shown by PV Sindhu in marathon badminton matches is world-class. Dismissing physical capability built through hard work goes against the sporting spirit.

hate_comment: Avalu divorce aadidale, ella avalu tappu iratte.
counter_speech: Divorce eradu vyaktigala madhyada complex relationship decision, yaara obbara mele matra blame haakodu thappu. Mutual respect illadiruva sambandhadinda horabarodu genuine courage aagidhe. Individual choices na empathy inda nodabeku, social stigma inda alla.
english_translation: Divorce is a complex relationship decision between two people; blaming one person alone is wrong. Walking away from an unworkable relationship requires genuine courage. Individual choices must be viewed with empathy, not social stigma.

hate_comment: Hennu makkalu politics ge barodu beda, dirty game.
counter_speech: Deshada population nalli ardha bhaga mahileyariddare, avara representation democracy nalli tumba avashyaka. Local panchayat inda parliament varagu mahila leaders transformative policies implement maadiddare. Inclusive politics system na clean mattu responsive maadoke sahaya aagutte.
english_translation: Women make up half the country's population, making their representation in a democracy essential. From local panchayats to parliament, women leaders have implemented transformative policies. Inclusive politics helps make the system clean and responsive.

hate_comment: Girls ge gaming alli skills illa, boys jothe compete maadalla.
counter_speech: Gaming skills reflex, strategic thinking mattu practice mele grow aaguttave. Global esports tournament galalli competitive female gamers top teams nalli excel maadtiro trend beleyuttide. Stereotypes drop maadi supportive gaming community build maadona.
english_translation: Gaming skills grow through reflexes, strategic thinking and practice. In global esports tournaments, competitive female gamers excelling in top teams is a growing trend. Let us drop stereotypes and build a supportive gaming community.

hate_comment: Hennu teacher matra aagbahudu, engineering college ge principal aagalla.
counter_speech: Principal position academic scholarship, administrative excellence mattu vision demand maadutte. Namma state nalli aneka premier engineering institutes nalli mahila principals institution na successfully guide maadiddare. Professional leadership capabilities qualifications mele nillatte.
english_translation: The position of a principal demands academic scholarship, administrative excellence and vision. In our state, women principals in several premier engineering institutes have successfully guided institutions. Professional leadership capabilities depend on qualifications.

hate_comment: Hudugir ge financial freedom kottre control sigalla.
counter_speech: 'Control' maaduva concept equality ge viruddha aagidhe. Financial independence manushyage self-confidence, dignity mattu emergency backup kodutte. Kutumbadalli mutual trust mattu partnership iddaaga control maaduva avashyakateye iralla.
english_translation: The concept of 'controlling' someone opposes equality. Financial independence gives an individual self-confidence, dignity and emergency backup. When mutual trust and partnership exist in a family, there is no need for control.

hate_comment: Hennu pilot aagidre passenger ge tension, safe flight agalla.
counter_speech: Commercial aviation nalli highest percentage of female pilots iro countries nalli India mundidhe antha DGCA statistics thorsuthe. Pilot licensing rigorous training mattu simulator testing passing mele decide aagutte. Flying safety training mattu alertness mele nillatte.
english_translation: DGCA statistics show India is among countries with the highest percentage of female pilots in commercial aviation. Pilot licensing is decided on passing rigorous training and simulator tests. Flight safety depends on training and alertness.

hate_comment: Hudugiru tumba demand maadtare, madve budget increase maadtare.
counter_speech: Marriage expenses parents, traditions mattu societal pressure inda expand aagbahudu, adakke mahileyaranna matra blame maadodu sariyalla. Today aneka youth simple court marriages mattu meaningful ceremonies prefer maadtiro positive change baruttide.
english_translation: Marriage expenses often expand due to family expectations, traditions and societal pressure; blaming women alone is unfair. Today many youth prefer simple court marriages and meaningful ceremonies, bringing a positive change.

hate_comment: Hennu auto driver aagidre society ge shame.
counter_speech: Dudidhu baaluvudhu prathiyobba shramikana gourava, adhralli yavude shame illa. Tamma swanta kashta ninda auto odisi family run maadtiro mahileyaru real dignity of labour thorsidhaare. Honest livelihood na respect maadi encourage maadodu namma kartavya.
english_translation: Earning a living with hard work is the dignity of every worker; there is no shame in it. Women who run autos to support their families show the real dignity of labour. Respecting and encouraging an honest livelihood is our duty.

hate_comment: Girls ge startup maado dhairya illa, risk tumba jaasti.
counter_speech: Nykaa, Biocon, Sugar Cosmetics antha iconic startups mahila entrepreneurs kattiro successful ventures. Entrepreneurship market awareness, resilience mattu product execution mele depend aagutte. Calculated risks yaarigadru success tharutte, gender ge alladha gunavu idhu.
english_translation: Iconic startups like Nykaa, Biocon and Sugar Cosmetics are successful ventures built by women entrepreneurs. Entrepreneurship depends on market awareness, resilience and product execution. Taking calculated risks brings success to anyone, irrespective of gender.

hate_comment: Hennu lawyer court alli argument maadoke agalla, soft nature.
counter_speech: Supreme Court mattu High Courts nalli landmark constitutional judgments argue maadi win maadidha mahila advocatesiddare. Legal profession evidence, analytical jurisprudence mattu preparation demand maadutte. Argumentative clarity discipline ninda baratte, gender inda alla.
english_translation: There are accomplished women advocates in the Supreme Court and High Courts who have argued and won landmark constitutional judgments. The legal profession demands evidence, analytical jurisprudence and preparation. Argumentative clarity comes from discipline, not gender.

hate_comment: Hudugi smoke athava drink maadidre moral illada avalu.
counter_speech: Health habits medical factors mele impact beelthave, aadre moral character judge maadoke double standards use maadodu sariyalla. Men ge ondhu rule, women ge innondu standard apply maadodu hypocrisy. Personal lifestyle choices respect mattu health guidance inda nodona.
english_translation: Health habits impact medical well-being, but using double standards to judge moral character is unfair. Applying one rule for men and another for women is hypocrisy. Let us look at lifestyle choices through mutual respect and health awareness.

hate_comment: Hennu makkalu army frontline combat ge hodre country lose agutte.
counter_speech: Indian Armed Forces mahileyarige permanent commission mattu fighter pilot streams open maadi national security ge integrate maadidhe. Combat readiness mental resilience, firing proficiency mattu teamwork mele evaluate aagutte. Avara deshaseveya samarpanatheya naavu gauravisabeku.
english_translation: The Indian Armed Forces have granted permanent commission and fighter pilot streams to women, integrating them into national security. Combat readiness is evaluated through mental resilience, firing proficiency and teamwork. We must honor their dedication to the country.

hate_comment: Girls ge solo travel yaake, dangerous mattu irresponsible.
counter_speech: Solo travel vyaktitvada self-confidence, situational awareness mattu cultural exposure grow maadoke utthama opportunity. Planned travel, safe staying accommodations mattu digital navigation inda thousands of women safely travel maadtiro reality ide. World explore maado hakku ellarigu ide.
english_translation: Solo travel is a wonderful opportunity to grow self-confidence, situational awareness and cultural exposure. With planned itineraries, safe accommodations and digital navigation, thousands of women travel safely today. Everyone has the right to explore the world.

hate_comment: Hennu scientist aagidre lab research slow agutte.
counter_speech: Chandrayaan mattu Mars Orbiter Mission nalli ISRO mahila scientists crucial leadership roles play maadiddare. Scientific discovery systematic experimentation, rigor mattu curiosity mele nillatte. Gender based baseless claims scientific community ethics ge shobhe tharalla.
english_translation: ISRO women scientists played crucial leadership roles in Chandrayaan and Mars Orbiter Missions. Scientific discovery relies on systematic experimentation, rigor and curiosity. Baseless claims based on gender do not suit scientific community ethics.

hate_comment: Hudugir ge tech review maado knowledge illa, beauty vlogs maadi.
counter_speech: Tech specifications, processor architecture, benchmarking mattu camera sensors evaluate maado tech creators mahileyaralli kooda internationally famous iddhaare. Content quality technical depth mele nillatte. Yaaru yaava domain choose maadbeku antha restrict maadodu irrelevant.
english_translation: There are globally celebrated female tech creators evaluating processor architecture, benchmarks and camera sensors. Content quality rests on technical depth. Restricting scientific or tech domains based on gender is irrelevant.

hate_comment: Hennu singer aadre marryage ge problem, stage mele hogabaaradu.
counter_speech: Sangeetha, naatya mattu kala saadhane namma cultural heritage ge amoolyavada kanike. Stage performance artistic dedication thorsuthe, adhu kutumba jeevanakke yavude thondare tharalla. Kalavidaranna encourage maadi avara talent gauravisuvudhu cultured society lakshana.
english_translation: Music, dance and artistic mastery are invaluable contributions to our cultural heritage. Stage performance shows artistic dedication and poses no hindrance to family life. Encouraging artists and honoring their talent is the mark of a cultured society.

hate_comment: Hudugi ond sari fail aadre anthaane, hennu makkalu odukke ladalla.
counter_speech: Academic setbacks learning curve nalli sahajavada bhaaga, adannu gender jothe link maadodu thappu. Board exams mattu civil services ranking nalli top spots mahileyare saadhisiro examples continuous aagi barthive. Encouragement mattu second chance idre yaaru aadru comeback maadtaare.
english_translation: Academic setbacks are a natural part of the learning curve; linking them to gender is inaccurate. Examples of women achieving top spots in board exams and civil services rankings appear continuously. With encouragement and a second chance, anyone can make a comeback.

hate_comment: Hennu makkalu army ge hogode beda, avaru weak.
counter_speech: Army training rigorous physical stamina, psychological grit mattu battlefield discipline require maadutte. All-women contingents Republic Day parade mattu UN Peacekeeping missions nalli outstanding performance thorsidhaare. Weakness antha label haakodu unproven assumptions, training capability decide maadutte.
english_translation: Army training requires rigorous physical stamina, psychological grit and battlefield discipline. All-women contingents have shown outstanding performance in Republic Day parades and UN Peacekeeping missions. Labeling them weak is an unproven assumption; training decides capability.

hate_comment: Housewife aadre ond kelsa illa, saakkke sumne mane alli iddare.
counter_speech: Mane nirvahane, child care, elderly support mattu cooking early morning inda night varagu continuous shrama thagolatte. Unpaid domestic labor kutumbada mattu nation economy nilli silently big contribution maaduthe. Housemakers kelsa na recognize maadi heartful respect kodona.
english_translation: Managing a home, childcare, elderly care and cooking requires continuous labour from early morning until night. Unpaid domestic work makes a silent, massive contribution to the family and national economy. Let us recognize homemakers' work with heartfelt respect.

hate_comment: Girls ge science fair gelloke baralla, gandu makkale gelluttare.
counter_speech: Science fairs nalli practical working models, scientific methodology mattu innovation basis mele evaluation aagutte. National children science congress nalli hudugiyaru sustainable tech projects display maadi medals geddiddare. Creativity mattu research passion prathiyobba student nalli nourish maadbeku.
english_translation: In science fairs, evaluations are made based on practical working models, scientific methodology and innovation. In national children science congresses, girls have displayed sustainable tech projects and won medals. We should nourish creativity and research passion in every student.

hate_comment: Hennu makkalu chikka vayassalli kelsa ge hogbaaradu, kutumba nodkoLi.
counter_speech: Early career start vyaktiya skills upgrade maadoke mattu financial self-reliance thandhukoLLoke sahaya aagutte. Modern families nalli mutual understanding inda career mattu domestic responsibilities manage maadabahudu. Freedom of profession samvidhana kottiro legal right aagidhe.
english_translation: Starting an early career helps upgrade skills and build financial self-reliance. In modern families, careers and domestic responsibilities can be managed through mutual understanding. Freedom of profession is a legal right granted by the constitution.

hate_comment: Girls ge hecchu freedom kodidre hodru, hudugru doubt maadtare.
counter_speech: Healthy relationships mutual trust, open communication mattu equality mele nillathtave, doubt athava restriction mele alla. Swatantrya prathiyobba nagarikana dignity ge prerequisite. Suspicion bittu respect mattu positive encouragement kododu mature mindset lakshana.
english_translation: Healthy relationships stand on mutual trust, open communication and equality, not on doubt or restriction. Freedom is a prerequisite for every citizen's dignity. Leaving suspicion behind and offering respect and encouragement is the mark of a mature mindset.

hate_comment: Hennu makkalu hecchu maatadodu, gandu makkalu kelsa maadtare.
counter_speech: Communication style individual personality traits mele depend aagutte, gender mele alla. Agriculture, corporate offices, healthcare mattu administration nalli mahileyaru tireless effort haaki results produce maadtiro reality ide. Shrama yavattu gender nodi divide aagalla.
english_translation: Communication style depends on individual personality traits, not on gender. In agriculture, corporate offices, healthcare and administration, women put in tireless effort to produce results. Hard work is never divided by gender.

hate_comment: Hennu makkalu jaasti odidre madve agodu kashta.
counter_speech: Higher education manushyana analytical thinking, maturity mattu understanding capacity expand maadutte. Odhidha jodi mutually supportive marriage life lead maadoke better perspective iratte. Education yavattu life partnership ge hurdle aagalla, asset aagutte.
english_translation: Higher education expands a person's analytical thinking, maturity and capacity for understanding. An educated couple has a better perspective to lead a mutually supportive married life. Education is never a hurdle to a life partnership, but an asset.

hate_comment: Hudugi singal aagidre safe alla, protection beku.
counter_speech: Surakshe anuvadhu effective law enforcement, well-lit public infrastructure mattu civilized society moolaka create aagabeku. Single person lifestyle choice, adakke restrictions haakodhu sariyalla. Samvidhana prathiyobba nagarikanigu independent aagi jeevisuva security guarantee kodutte.
english_translation: Safety must be created through effective law enforcement, well-lit public infrastructure and a civilized society. Being single is a lifestyle choice; imposing restrictions on it is unfair. The constitution guarantees security for every citizen to live independently.

hate_comment: Hennu coach aagidre team gelalla, hudugru coach beku.
counter_speech: Coaching capability tactical game reading, player psychology mattu leadership temperament mele depend aagutte. National athletic teams nalli female coaches training kottu international championships win maadisiro historical track record ide. Mentorship skills gender inda limit aagalla.
english_translation: Coaching capability depends on tactical game reading, player psychology and leadership temperament. Female coaches training national athletic teams have a historical track record of winning international championships. Mentorship skills are not limited by gender.

hate_comment: Hennu makkalu bhaara etthodu beda, gandu makkalu maadli.
counter_speech: Physical ergonomics, fitness training mattu safety techniques use maadidre heavy tasks successfully handle maadabahudu. Agriculture, warehouse logistics mattu construction sectors nalli mahileyaru daily heavy work handle maadtiro reality namma mundidhe. Strength training open for all.
english_translation: Using physical ergonomics, fitness training and safety techniques enables successful handling of heavy tasks. In agriculture, warehouse logistics and construction sectors, women handle heavy work daily. Strength training is open to all.

hate_comment: Ond hennu CEO aagidre company moriyutte.
counter_speech: Corporate governance, financial strategy mattu stakeholder trust mele enterprise success nirnayavagutte. Fortune 500 company leaders nalli mahila CEOs outstanding shareholder returns thorsiddare. Leadership excellence merit, foresight mattu execution capacity mele nillatte, gender mele alla.
english_translation: Enterprise success is determined by corporate governance, financial strategy and stakeholder trust. Female CEOs among Fortune 500 companies have demonstrated outstanding shareholder returns. Leadership excellence rests on merit, foresight and execution capacity, not gender.

hate_comment: Ee party ge vote hakidavru ellaru murkharu, avarige yochane illa.
counter_speech: Prajaprabhutvadalli prathiyobba nagarikanigu tanna prashnegalu mattu abhiprayagala aadharada mele vote maaduva swatantrya ide. Matadarara theerppannu apahasisuvadara badalu, governance issues mattu policies bagge aadarayuta charchisuvudu arogyakara rajakaranada lakshana.
english_translation: In a democracy, every citizen has the freedom to vote based on their concerns and opinions. Rather than ridiculing voters' choices, discussing governance issues and policies with mutual respect is the sign of healthy politics.

hate_comment: Ella politicians kalla, yaarannu nambabaaradu.
counter_speech: Corruption ondhu gambhira samasye aagidru, ella janapratinidhigalannu blanket aagi blame maadodu sariyalla. Tumba netaaru dedicated public service nalli kelsa maadtiddare. System reform aagalu RTI, lokayukta mattu jaagrukata voting tumba mukhya.
english_translation: While corruption is a serious problem, blaming all public representatives indiscriminately is unfair. Many leaders work with dedicated public service. To reform the system, RTI, the Lokayukta and vigilant voting are essential.

hate_comment: Opposition party avaru deshadrohi, avarannu jail ge haaki.
counter_speech: Strong opposition prajaprabhutvada praanavaayuvinanthe, adhu government policies na balance mattu scrutinize maadutte. Dissent athava vimarshe maaduvudhu deshadroha alla, adhu samvidhanika hakku. Healthy debate namma democratic institutions na balapadisutte.
english_translation: A strong opposition is like the lifeblood of democracy; it scrutinizes and balances government policies. Expressing dissent or critique is not treason, but a constitutional right. Healthy debate strengthens our democratic institutions.

hate_comment: Namma MLA ge kelsa gottilla, ond kaiyalli duddu tumbikondidare.
counter_speech: Public fund usage mattu local development bagge prashne keluvudu prathiyobba citizen na hakku. Corruption allegations iddare Lokayukta, RTI athava audit reports moolaka legal evidence jothe challenge maadona. Proof illade nindhane maadodakinta accountability demand maadodu utthama.
english_translation: Questioning public fund usage and local development is the right of every citizen. If corruption allegations exist, let us challenge them with legal evidence via Lokayukta, RTI or audit reports. Demanding accountability is better than unproven name-calling.

hate_comment: Ee sarkaara ge hogi vote hakidre desha naasha aagutte.
counter_speech: Election time nalli fears spread maadodara badalu party policies, developmental track record mattu manifestos compare maadbeku. Democratic change matadana moolaka shantiyuathavagi barutte. Negative propaganda bittu factual performance mele analyze maadona.
english_translation: Rather than spreading fear during elections, we should compare party policies, developmental track records and manifestos. Democratic change comes peacefully through voting. Let us analyze factual performance rather than relying on negative propaganda.

hate_comment: Ivanu ond party ge sellout, avanige maatu heLoke yogyate illa.
counter_speech: Vyaktiya yogyatheya mele personal attack maadodara badalu avaru mandisidha arguments nalli enu facts ive antha examine maadbeku. Rashtriya charche nalli civil language mattu factual counters balisidre discussion productive aagutte.
english_translation: Instead of launching personal attacks on someone's credibility, we should examine the factual merit of their arguments. Using civil language and factual counter-arguments in public discourse makes discussions truly productive.

hate_comment: Election alli duddu togondu vote hakodu normal, ellaru haage.
counter_speech: Vote marukolluvudu prajaprabhutvakke dohadravaada kelsa mattu illegal offense. Clean governance beku andre matadararu money power reject maadi integrity iro candidates na choose maadbeku. Honest election ninda matra utthama bhavishya saadhya.
english_translation: Selling votes betrays democracy and is an illegal offence. If we want clean governance, voters must reject money power and choose candidates with integrity. A bright future is possible only through honest elections.

hate_comment: Yuvakaru politics ge baralla, avarige anubhava illa.
counter_speech: Youth fresh perspective, technology awareness mattu innovative solutions thandhu public governance enrich maadtaare. Experience kalike inda barutte, aadre youth idealism mattu energy reform ge bahala avashyaka. Yuvajanara political participation deshakke shakti.
english_translation: Youth bring fresh perspectives, technology awareness and innovative solutions to enrich public governance. Experience comes with learning, but youth idealism and energy are vital for reform. Youth participation in politics strengthens the nation.

hate_comment: Ee neta tumba swarthi, janara bagge chintisalla.
counter_speech: Politicians accountability track maadodu avashyaka, adakke public meetings, RTI petitions mattu assembly attendance data verify maadbahudu. Individual leaders performance na baseline facts mele assess maadona. Emotional outrage bittu evidence-based feedback reform tharutte.
english_translation: Tracking politicians' accountability is essential, which can be verified through public meetings, RTI petitions and assembly attendance data. Let us assess individual leaders' performance on baseline facts. Evidence-based feedback brings reform rather than emotional outrage.

hate_comment: Vote hakodu waste, ellaru ond thara.
counter_speech: Apathy rajakarana nalli badalavane tharalla; local infrastructure, sanitation mattu healthcare policy namma vote indane nirdhaaravagutte. Ondhu single vote margin inda legislative balance badalaada aneka charithre namma mundide. Hakku chalaayisuvudu namma moola kartavya.
english_translation: Apathy will not change politics; local infrastructure, sanitation and healthcare policy are decided through our vote. History shows many elections where legislative balances shifted on a single vote. Exercising our right to vote is our fundamental duty.

hate_comment: Janarannu bhrashta maadiddare sarkaara, namage yaaru eno madalla.
counter_speech: Government institutions nalli inefficiencies irabahudu, aadare right to service acts, digital delivery portals mattu grievance helplines citizens empowerment ge help maadiddave. System transparent aagoke proactive citizen engagement mattu social audits tumba effective.
english_translation: Inefficiencies may exist in government institutions, but right to service acts, digital delivery portals and grievance helplines have helped empower citizens. Proactive citizen engagement and social audits are very effective in making systems transparent.

hate_comment: Ee party fans ge ond kelsa illa, social media alli hechchu bartare.
counter_speech: Social media nalli political discourse civil aagirabeku. Troll culture reject maadi, developmental issues, unemployment mattu education bagge factual debates nadisuvudu constructive aagiratte. Digital platforms democratic awareness belasoke use aagali.
english_translation: Political discourse on social media should remain civil. Rejecting troll culture and holding factual debates on developmental issues, unemployment and education is constructive. Let digital platforms be used to foster democratic awareness.

hate_comment: Hosa party andre dodda neeru, gelalla.
counter_speech: Multi-party democracy nalli hosa political movements alternative policy solutions provide maadoke bandhirthave. Competing viewpoints electoral choices na enrich maadtave. Hosa parties viability avara public mandate mattu ground work mele decide aagabeku.
english_translation: In a multi-party democracy, new political movements emerge to provide alternative policy solutions. Competing viewpoints enrich electoral choices. The viability of new parties should be determined by their public mandate and ground work.

hate_comment: Sarkaari kelsa ge baro nowkarru ellaru kadime kelsa maaduva.
counter_speech: Public sector nalli millions of doctors, teachers, police personnel mattu clerks difficult conditions nalli sincere seva maadtiro reality ide. Administrative delay idre systemic process automation beku. Prathiyobba employee na generalise maadi insult maadodu fair alla.
english_translation: Millions of doctors, teachers, police personnel and clerks in the public sector serve sincerely under difficult conditions. Where administrative delays exist, systemic process automation is required. Indiscriminately insulting every employee is unfair.

hate_comment: Ee neta ge vote hakidavaru deshadrohi.
counter_speech: Prajaprabhutvadalli constitution prathi matadararigu secret ballot hakku kottide. Rashtra premada certificate yaarigu exclusive aagi sigalla. Ideological differences respect maadi public welfare issues mele consensus build maadodu namma sanvidhanada mulabhutha dhyeya.
english_translation: In a democracy, the constitution grants every voter the right to a secret ballot. No one holds an exclusive monopoly on patriotism. Respecting ideological differences and building consensus on public welfare is the fundamental spirit of our constitution.

hate_comment: Ella channels paid media, nambodu beda.
counter_speech: Media bias bagge critical awareness iruvudu olleyadhu, aadare independent journalists mattu fact-checkers truth uncover maadtiro effort appreciate maadbeku. Diverse sources compare maadi fact-checking habits belesikondre propaganda trap ninda safe aagirabahudu.
english_translation: Having critical awareness regarding media bias is good, but the effort of independent journalists and fact-checkers uncovering the truth should be appreciated. Comparing diverse sources and fostering fact-checking habits protects against falling into propaganda traps.

hate_comment: Neevu ee neta ge support maadtira andre neevu kooda bhrashta.
counter_speech: Political support bere bere priorities, regional issues mattu leadership qualities mele base aagirthade. Supporter galannu corrupt antha label maadidre mutual communication shut aagutte. Disagreements na dignified debate inda address maaduvudu civilized approach.
english_translation: Political support is based on differing priorities, regional issues and leadership qualities. Labelling supporters as corrupt shuts down mutual communication. Addressing disagreements through dignified debate is the civilized approach.

hate_comment: Ee sarkaara yaavattu kelsa maadilla, ellaa poverty ide.
counter_speech: Poverty reduction continuous policy effort demand maadutte. Past decades nalli welfare schemes, electrification, rural sanitation mattu education expansion ninda measurable progress aagidhe. Still gaps solve maadalu data-based constructive feedback sarakarakke push maadbeku.
english_translation: Poverty reduction demands continuous policy effort. Over past decades, measurable progress has occurred through welfare schemes, electrification, rural sanitation and educational expansion. To close remaining gaps, we must push data-based constructive feedback to the government.

hate_comment: Namma party ge matra vote hakli, bere party ge hakidre desha dhrohi.
counter_speech: Political plurality namma samvidhanada soul aagidhe. Virodha pakshagala presence power concentration na check maadoke mandatory. Voting choice na treason jothe equate maaduvudu democratic values na undermine maadidante aagutte.
english_translation: Political plurality is the soul of our constitution. The presence of opposition parties is mandatory to check power concentration. Equating voting choices with treason undermines democratic values.

hate_comment: Politics ge oLLe janaru baralla, ellaru kalla.
counter_speech: Ethical individuals civil society inda public office ge barlilla andre dishonest players monopoly establish aagutte. Swachha rajakaranakke integrity iro janarannu identify maadi support maadodu namma responsibility. Cynicism bittu clean governance movements strengthen maadona.
english_translation: If ethical individuals from civil society do not enter public office, dishonest players establish a monopoly. It is our responsibility to identify and support people with integrity for clean politics. Let us leave cynicism behind and strengthen clean governance movements.

hate_comment: Ee neta ge hige bartane, aadru janaru vote hakthare, jana murkhar.
counter_speech: Matadararu tamma local developmental needs, access mattu community representation nodi vote theermaana maadtaare. Citizen choices na disrespect maadodara badalu voters ge alternative viable visions present maadi convince maaduvudu democratic tradition.
english_translation: Voters decide their vote considering their local developmental needs, accessibility and community representation. Rather than disrespecting citizen choices, presenting and convincing voters with viable alternative visions is the democratic tradition.

hate_comment: Opposition leader andre ond kelsa illa, sumne criticize maadtare.
counter_speech: Legislation scrutinize maadodu, bills review maadi amendments propose maadodu mattu public interest issues raise maadodu opposition leader duty. Constructive criticism policy loopholes plug maadoke help maadutte. Democracy checks and balances inda sustain aagutte.
english_translation: Scrutinizing legislation, reviewing bills to propose amendments and raising public interest issues is the duty of opposition leaders. Constructive criticism helps plug policy loopholes. Democracy sustains itself on checks and balances.

hate_comment: Chunavane time alli matra janara kade baro neta.
counter_speech: Elected representatives year-round public accessible aagirabeku anuvadhu nyayayutha apeksha. Citizen groups constituency offices nalli regular progress reports demand maadi ongoing accountability maintain maadabahudu. Active citizenry leadership na continuous active aagiruvanthe maadutte.
english_translation: Expecting elected representatives to be accessible year-round to the public is a legitimate expectation. Citizen groups can demand regular progress reports at constituency offices to maintain ongoing accountability. Active citizenry keeps leadership continuously engaged.

hate_comment: Ee sarkaara ge matra janarannu govern madodu baralla.
counter_speech: Governance effectiveness specific sectors nalli measure aagutte, eg. healthcare, rural roads, fiscal management mattu law order. Blanket condemnation bittu specific policy failures na pin-point maadi alternative models suggest maaduvudu effective civic advocacy.
english_translation: Governance effectiveness is measured across specific sectors like healthcare, rural roads, fiscal management and law and order. Pinpointing specific policy failures and suggesting alternative models is far more effective civic advocacy than blanket condemnation.

hate_comment: Ivaru vote bank rajakaarani maadthare, ond jaati ge matra.
counter_speech: Caste-based polarising politics social development ge baadhaka aagidhe. Broad-based development policies — shikshana, employment, irrigation mattu healthcare — ella samudaayagala upliftment saadhya maadtave. Policy-based issues mele voting focus shift maaduvudu namma priority aagali.
english_translation: Caste-based polarising politics obstructs social development. Broad-based development policies — education, employment, irrigation and healthcare — uplift all communities. Shifting voting focus towards policy-based issues must be our priority.

hate_comment: Ee neta ge accent sari illa, avaru Kannada maatadalla, namma jana alla.
counter_speech: Karnataka da vivadha pranthyagalalli — Coastal, Malnad, Kalyana Karnataka, Mumbai Karnataka — Kannada accents natural aagi diversify aagirthave. Linguistic diversity namma bhsheya shakti. Dialect nodi discrimination maadodhu internal unity ge haanikara.
english_translation: Across Karnataka's diverse regions — Coastal, Malnad, Kalyana Karnataka, Mumbai Karnataka — Kannada accents naturally diversify. Linguistic diversity is the strength of our language. Discriminating against dialects harms our internal unity.

hate_comment: Party kaaryakartaru ellaru goondagalu.
counter_speech: Grassroots party volunteers public mobilization, disaster relief coordination mattu voter awareness programs nalli actively assist maadtaare. Violence athava hooliganism iddare law strictly prosecute maadbeku. Aadare peaceful civic engagement nalli involved party workers na generalize maadabeda.
english_translation: Grassroots party volunteers actively assist in public mobilization, disaster relief coordination and voter awareness programs. Where violence or hooliganism occurs, the law must strictly prosecute. However, do not generalize peaceful party workers involved in civic engagement.

hate_comment: Vote hakodu avara dharma ge virudhdha, haakbeda.
counter_speech: Prajaprabhutvadalli matadana prathiyobba nagarikana samvidhanika hakku mattu rashtra nirmana kartavya. Yaavude dharma civic participation athava samaja seveyannu thadeyolla. Bhayada badalu swatantra aagi vote haaki namma pratinidhigalannu nirdharisona.
english_translation: In a democracy, voting is every citizen's constitutional right and nation-building duty. No religion forbids civic participation or social service. Let us vote freely and decide our representatives without fear.

hate_comment: Ee neta ge degree illa, avanu rajakaarani ge yogya alla.
counter_speech: Formal degrees value ide, aadare grassroots understanding, empathy, ground leadership mattu mass connect kooda politics nalli crucial aaguttave. Dr. Ambedkar avaru inclusive franchise guarantee maadidru. Public service delivery competence formal credentials kinta mukhya.
english_translation: Formal degrees have value, but grassroots understanding, empathy, grounded leadership and mass connect are equally crucial in politics. Dr. Ambedkar guaranteed inclusive franchise for this reason. Competence in public service delivery matters more than formal credentials.

hate_comment: Yaarannu nambabeda, ellaru swarthagalu.
counter_speech: Total distrust democracy na weaken maadutte mattu authoritarianism ge daari maadutte. Honest public servants, RTI activists mattu progressive leaders positive transformation thandhiro instances ide. Vigilant aagiruvudu olleyadu, aadare total hopelessness progress na arrest maadutte.
english_translation: Total distrust weakens democracy and opens the door to authoritarianism. There are instances where honest public servants, RTI activists and progressive leaders brought positive transformation. Being vigilant is good, but total hopelessness halts progress.

hate_comment: Ee party yellaa vishayadalli doubleface maadutte.
counter_speech: Policy shifts athava contradictory stands track maadoke election manifestos mattu legislative voting records verify maadabahudu. Political accountability empirical facts mele challenge aagabeku. Record evidence review maadi public interest balance assess maadona.
english_translation: To track policy shifts or contradictory positions, election manifestos and legislative voting records can be verified. Political accountability should be challenged on empirical facts. Let us review recorded evidence to assess public interest balances.

hate_comment: Sarkaara kodo yojane ellaa vote ge laanchha.
counter_speech: Targeted welfare programs — eg. subsidized rations, direct benefit transfers, scholarship grants — vulnerable populations na distress ninda save maadoke design aagirthave. Scheme fiscal sustainability bagge audit questions legit, aadare poor relief na bribe antha treat maadodu insensitive.
english_translation: Targeted welfare programs like subsidized rations, direct benefit transfers and scholarship grants are designed to protect vulnerable populations from distress. While audit questions regarding scheme sustainability are legitimate, treating relief for the poor as a bribe is insensitive.

hate_comment: Ee neta ge speech koDodu matra baralla, kelsa maadalla.
counter_speech: Oratory skills communication ge sahaya aagidru, ground implementation results crucial. Constituency development funds utilization mattu completed civic works review maadi actual performance track maadbahudu. Rhetoric assess maadadhe concrete infrastructure delivery evaluate maadona.
english_translation: While oratory skills aid communication, ground implementation results are crucial. Actual performance can be tracked by reviewing constituency development fund utilization and completed civic works. Let us evaluate concrete infrastructure delivery rather than assessing rhetoric.

hate_comment: Vote hakodakke jaati nodabeku, bere jaati ge hakabeda.
counter_speech: Caste lines mele vote haakidre corruption, poor infrastructure mattu unemployment samasye solve aagolla. Candidate competence, honesty mattu community development vision nodi vote haakodhu namma constituency future ge mandatory. Identity politics bittu development ge vote maadona.
english_translation: Voting on caste lines will not solve problems like corruption, poor infrastructure and unemployment. Voting by considering candidate competence, honesty and vision for community development is mandatory for our constituency's future. Let us move past identity politics and vote for development.

hate_comment: Social media alli raajakeeya charche beda, ellaru jagala maadtare.
counter_speech: Social media nalli toxic fights bittu fact-based, respectful discussion maadbahudu. Civil disagreement namma democratic maturity thorsuthe. Abusing maado badalu policy documents mattu credible statistics quote maadi discussion standard raise maadona.
english_translation: Rather than toxic arguments, fact-based and respectful discussion is possible on social media. Civil disagreement reflects our democratic maturity. Instead of trading abuses, let us raise the standard of debate by citing policy documents and credible statistics.

hate_comment: Ee chunavane gelalu neta ond kaage maadthane.
counter_speech: Election malpractices thadeyalu Election Commission of India strict Model Code of Conduct enforce maadutte. False claims athava illegal inducements kandubandre cVIGIL app moolaka complaints file maadi swift legal action thagolabahudu. Evidence-based vigilance election integrity kapadutte.
english_translation: To prevent election malpractices, the Election Commission of India strictly enforces the Model Code of Conduct. If false claims or illegal inducements are observed, complaints can be filed via the cVIGIL app for swift legal action. Evidence-based vigilance preserves election integrity.

hate_comment: Hosa neeti ge virudhdha haakidavaru deshadrohi.
counter_speech: Samvidhana Article 19 prathi nagarikanigu shanthiyuthavagi protest maaduva mattu policy critique maaduva hakku kottide. Policy objections democratic dialogue na refine maadtave. Dissenting voices na deshadrohi antha label maaduvudu democratic principles ge bipareetha.
english_translation: Article 19 of the constitution guarantees every citizen the right to protest peacefully and critique policy. Policy objections help refine democratic dialogue. Labelling dissenting voices as anti-national contradicts democratic principles.

hate_comment: Ee party ge yaaru vote hakadilla, avaru ond jana.
counter_speech: Election outcomes prathiyobba citizen na preference combine maaduttave. Diverse choices multi-party democracy da strength. Majority opinion respect maaduvagale minority viewpoints protect maaduva balance samvidhana mandate maadide.
english_translation: Election outcomes combine the preferences of every individual citizen. Diverse choices are the strength of multi-party democracy. While respecting majority decisions, the constitution mandates the protection of minority viewpoints.

hate_comment: Ee neta tumba dhaarmika swaroopada maatu heLthane, rajakaarana ge dharma haakthane.
counter_speech: Secular democracy nalli state governance constitutional principles, rule of law mattu equal treatment mele nadibeku. Religious symbolism public policy decisions inda separate aagirabeku. Leaders performance infrastructure, education mattu public health outcomes mele evaluate aagali.
english_translation: In a secular democracy, state governance must run on constitutional principles, the rule of law and equal treatment. Religious symbolism should remain distinct from public policy decisions. Leaders' performance must be evaluated on infrastructure, education and public health outcomes.

hate_comment: Rajakeeya party andre janarannu mosa maadodu.
counter_speech: Political parties ideological platform mattu policy manifestos create maadoke organize aagirthave. Public scrutiny, free press mattu regular elections false promises na exposed maadtave. Active citizenship democratic accountability maintain maado ultimate safeguard.
english_translation: Political parties organize to create ideological platforms and policy manifestos. Public scrutiny, a free press and regular elections expose empty promises. Active citizenship is the ultimate safeguard for maintaining democratic accountability.

hate_comment: Ee neta ge vayassaaytu, retire aagli.
counter_speech: Governance nalli age factor kinta vision, physical fitness, mental alertness mattu delivery capacity mukhya. Experienced elder statesmen guidance mattu dynamic young leaders energy combine aadaaga polity balanced aagiratte. Stereotyping bittu contribution mele judge maadona.
english_translation: In governance, vision, physical fitness, mental alertness and delivery capacity matter more than age alone. When the guidance of experienced elder statesmen combines with the energy of dynamic young leaders, polity remains balanced. Let us judge contributions rather than stereotyping age.

hate_comment: Sarkaara kelsa ge baro nowkarru lanchha togolodu normal.
counter_speech: Bribery normalize maadodhu administrative ethics na hani maadutte. Anti-Corruption Bureau, digital payment gateways mattu faceless scrutiny schemes corruption space reduce maadtiro positive initiatives. Bribery report maadi clean public services enforce maadodu namma kartavya.
english_translation: Normalizing bribery damages administrative ethics. Anti-Corruption Bureau, digital payment gateways and faceless scrutiny initiatives are positive steps reducing avenues for corruption. Reporting bribery and enforcing clean public services is our duty.

hate_comment: Ee neta ge matra hosa yojane, nammage enu aagalla.
counter_speech: Government schemes public entitlement guidelines prakaara universal eligibility follow maadbeku. Scheme benefits access aagadilla andre grama panchayat, district administration athava grievance portals moolaka appeal sallisabahudu. Information empowerment rights reclaim maadoke help maadutte.
english_translation: Government schemes must follow universal eligibility according to public entitlement guidelines. If scheme benefits are inaccessible, appeals can be filed via gram panchayats, district administrations or grievance portals. Information empowerment helps reclaim rights.

hate_comment: Rajakeeya cartoon andre amaanya, ban maadi.
counter_speech: Political satire mattu editorial cartoons freedom of expression da iconic tradition aagidhe, adhu power accountability check maadoke use aagutte. RK Laxman antha legend cartoonists democracy spirit elevate maadidha charithre ide. Censorship badalu creative humour appreciate maadona.
english_translation: Political satire and editorial cartoons are an iconic tradition of freedom of expression that helps check power accountability. Legendary cartoonists like RK Laxman historically elevated the spirit of democracy. Let us appreciate creative humour rather than resorting to censorship.

hate_comment: Ee party ge kelsa kodidre namma ge tondare.
counter_speech: Parties governance track record manifestos, legislative past performance mattu policy focus mele verify maadbahudu. Fear-mongering political claims bittu factual governance merits debate maaduvudu voter welfare ge help aagutte.
english_translation: Parties' governance track records can be verified through manifestos, legislative past performance and policy focus. Debating factual governance merits rather than fear-mongering claims assists voter welfare.

hate_comment: Yaaru neta aadru ond, namma jeevana badalalla.
counter_speech: Civic amenities, road networks, government hospitals mattu school education policy namma daily living directly shape maadtave. Policy change gradual aagidru, committed leadership concrete difference tharutte. Civic participation ninda positive badalavane generate maadabahudu.
english_translation: Civic amenities, road networks, government hospitals and school education policy directly shape our daily living. Although policy changes are gradual, committed leadership brings concrete differences. Positive transformation can be generated through civic participation.

hate_comment: Ee neta ge hagalu ratri janara sahaya maadalla.
counter_speech: Public servants systemic development work, administrative meetings mattu legislative policy nalli invest maadbeku. Ground presence emergency time nalli avashyaka. Systematic institution building long-term results tharuthe, kevala photo-op visits alla.
english_translation: Public servants must invest in systemic development work, administrative meetings and legislative policy. While ground presence is needed in emergencies, systematic institution building delivers long-term results, not mere photo-op visits.

hate_comment: Kannada sarkaara andre matra Bengaluru, hallige enu illa.
counter_speech: Regional balanced development state government obligation aagidhe. Rural electrification, Jal Jeevan Mission, MGNREGA mattu rural road schemes halli level development drive maadtiro initiatives. Regional funding allocation equitable aagirabeku anuvadhu legitimate civic demand.
english_translation: Balanced regional development is an obligation of the state government. Rural electrification, Jal Jeevan Mission, MGNREGA and rural road schemes are initiatives driving village-level development. Demanding equitable regional funding allocation is legitimate civic advocacy.

hate_comment: Panchayat sadasyaru ellaru kelsa maadalla, matte election ge matra bartare.
counter_speech: Gram Sabhas decentralized democracy nalli powerful platform. Prathiyobba halli nagarikaru Gram Sabha meetings nalli budget expenditure scrutinize maadi local works approve maadbahudu. People active participation local governance accountability ensure maadutte.
english_translation: Gram Sabhas are a powerful platform in decentralized democracy. Every village citizen can attend Gram Sabha meetings, scrutinize budget expenditures and approve local works. Active public participation ensures accountability in local governance.

hate_comment: Ellaa neta galu vote ge matra kaadi bartaare, chunavane mugidre kaaNalla.
counter_speech: Ongoing public engagement mechanisms — Janaspandana meetings, grievance helplines mattu constituency office visits — leadership na accountable aagidoke design aagidhe. Constant communication maintain maadi citizens civic issues pursue maaduvudu democracy balance kapadutte.
english_translation: Ongoing public engagement mechanisms like Janaspandana meetings, grievance helplines and constituency office visits are designed to hold leadership accountable. Maintaining constant communication and pursuing civic issues preserves the democratic balance.

hate_comment: Ella Muslims terrorists, avarannu namma area ge bidabaaradu.
counter_speech: Ondhu poora community na terrorism jothe equate maadodu tumba thappu mattu dangerous generalization. Deshada security, education, healthcare mattu science nalli Muslim nagarikaru dedicated seve maadiddare. Criminal acts individual accountability olapadathave, yaavude dharmavannu target maadabaaradu.
english_translation: Equating an entire community with terrorism is a deeply wrong and dangerous generalization. Muslim citizens have served with dedication across national security, education, healthcare and science. Criminal acts carry individual accountability; no religion should be collectively targeted.

hate_comment: Christians ge duddu kodi conversion maadtare, avarannu nambabaaradu.
counter_speech: Christian educational institutions, charitable hospitals mattu relief missions centuries ninda all communities ge selfless healthcare mattu education serve maadiddave. Forced athava fraudulent conversions illegal aagidhu law action thagolatte, aadre entire community integrity doubt maadodu unfair.
english_translation: Christian educational institutions, charitable hospitals and relief missions have provided selfless healthcare and education to all communities for centuries. Forced or fraudulent conversions are illegal and subject to law, but doubting the integrity of an entire community is unfair.

hate_comment: Hindus ellaru jaati ge hedaru, innu moodanambike.
counter_speech: Hindu tradition nalli Swami Vivekananda, Basaveshwara, Narayana Guru antha reformers caste rigidity mattu blind superstitions viruddha continuous reformative movements lead maadiddare. Diverse philosophical inquiry mattu progressive evolution namma cultural heritage da living tradition aagidhe.
english_translation: In Hindu tradition, reformers like Swami Vivekananda, Basaveshwara and Narayana Guru have continuously led reformative movements against caste rigidity and blind superstition. Diverse philosophical inquiry and progressive evolution are the living traditions of our cultural heritage.

hate_comment: Ee dharma avaru namma deshakke bandavaru, hogbeku.
counter_speech: Samvidhana Article 5 inda 11 prathi Indian citizen gu equal citizenship guarantee kodutte. Namma rashtra shathamaanagala vividha sanskrutigala coexistence mattu shared heritage mele kattalpattide. Dharmada aadharadalli exclusion maado maatu samvidhanika moulyagalige bipareetha.
english_translation: Articles 5 to 11 of the constitution guarantee equal citizenship to every Indian citizen. Our nation is built on centuries of cultural coexistence and shared heritage. Talking about exclusion based on religion contradicts constitutional values.

hate_comment: Avara hechhu makkalu agthave, namma jana kadime agtare.
counter_speech: National Family Health Survey data clearly thorsuthe fertility rates religion mele alla, female literacy, healthcare access mattu economic development mele decline aagtha bandhive. All communities nalli fertility rate national replacement rate kade move aagtiro demographical fact ide.
english_translation: National Family Health Survey data clearly shows that fertility rates decline based on female literacy, healthcare access and economic development, not religion. It is a demographic fact that fertility rates across all communities are converging towards the national replacement rate.

hate_comment: Ee hubba ge pataki hodi, avaru noise maadtare.
counter_speech: Festival celebrations ellarigu santosha tharuvanthe irabeku, hosa pollution athava noise pollution inda senior citizens, patients mattu animals ge thondare aagabaaradu. Sound regulations all religious festivals gu equally apply aagutte. Eco-friendly celebrations mutual respect kapadutte.
english_translation: Festival celebrations should bring joy to all without causing distress to senior citizens, patients and animals through pollution or noise. Sound regulations apply equally to all religious festivals. Eco-friendly celebrations maintain mutual respect.

hate_comment: Sikh avaru ellaru kalla, avara kade hogbeda.
counter_speech: Sikh community namma deshadha borders defense nalli sacrifice maadidha veera sainikara itihasa haagoo selfless langar service thanda jagath prasiddha tradition thorsidhe. Community na false stereotypes inda insult maadodu namma collective conscience ge shobhe tharalla.
english_translation: The Sikh community has a world-renowned tradition of brave soldiers defending our borders and selfless langar service feeding humanity. Insulting a community with false stereotypes does no credit to our collective conscience.

hate_comment: Atheists ge dharma gottilla, avaru adharmigalu.
counter_speech: Namma Indian philosophical tradition nalli Charvaka, Lokayata mattu rational inquiry centuries ninda respected traditions aagidhe. Morality, compassion mattu human empathy yaavude religious belief illade kooda deeply exist aagabahudu. Conscience freedom prathiyobbara constitutional right.
english_translation: In our Indian philosophical tradition, Charvaka, Lokayata and rational inquiry have been respected traditions for centuries. Morality, compassion and human empathy can deeply exist without religious belief. Freedom of conscience is everyone's constitutional right.

hate_comment: Mosque speaker alli daily kuugutaare, namma ge nidre illa.
counter_speech: Noise pollution control rules Supreme Court guidelines prakaara residential areas nalli strictly regulate aagirabeku. Decibel limits follow maadodu community harmony ge mandatory. Local administration aur resident welfare associations madhyasthike inda mutually agreeable timing schedule implement maadona.
english_translation: Noise pollution control rules must be strictly regulated in residential areas per Supreme Court guidelines. Adhering to decibel limits is mandatory for community harmony. Let us implement a mutually agreeable schedule through local administration and resident welfare associations.

hate_comment: Jains ellaru business karnaru, duddu thinnthaare.
counter_speech: Jain community ahimsa, philanthropy, educational trusts, goshale nirvahane mattu ethical business practices nalli amoolyavada contributions kottiddare. Ethical enterprise country economy na support maadutte. Sweeping prejudice bittu avara philanthropic traditions gauravisona.
english_translation: The Jain community has made invaluable contributions through non-violence, philanthropy, educational trusts, animal shelters and ethical business practices. Ethical enterprise supports the country's economy. Let us respect their philanthropic traditions rather than harboring sweeping prejudice.

hate_comment: Ee devastana ge hogidare andre superstitious, modern alla.
counter_speech: Devasthana, church athava masjid visit maadodu vyaktiya spiritual peace, contemplation mattu cultural grounding connection aagidhe. Spiritual belief mattu scientific rational outlook harmonious aagi coexist aagabahudu. Personal faith choices na ridicule maadodu broadmindedness alla.
english_translation: Visiting a temple, church or mosque connects an individual to spiritual peace, contemplation and cultural heritage. Spiritual belief and a rational scientific outlook can harmoniously coexist. Ridiculing personal faith choices is not a mark of broadmindedness.

hate_comment: Avara food habits namma sanskruti ge viruddha, band maadi.
counter_speech: India da culinary diversity vast geographic regions, climatic conditions mattu multi-faith heritage inda evolve aagidhe. Dietary habits individual personal liberty mattu cultural tradition da part. Forced dietary restrictions pluralistic democratic framework ge match aagolla.
english_translation: India's culinary diversity evolved across vast geographic regions, climatic conditions and multi-faith heritage. Dietary habits are part of personal liberty and cultural tradition. Imposing forced dietary restrictions does not suit a pluralistic democratic framework.

hate_comment: Inter-religious marriage aagidre love jihad antha artha.
counter_speech: Special Marriage Act 1954 prakaara eradu consenting adult citizens legal aagi inter-faith marriage enter aagoke samvidhanika hakku haaliddare. Coercion athava fraudulent deception illegal matters, aadare consensual relationships na generalized conspiracy theories inda criminalize maadodu civil rights viruddha.
english_translation: Under the Special Marriage Act 1954, two consenting adult citizens hold a constitutional right to enter an interfaith marriage legally. While coercion or deception are illegal, criminalizing consensual relationships through generalized conspiracy theories violates civil rights.

hate_comment: Avara script aur language namma deshakke foreign, ban aagabeku.
counter_speech: Urdu, Sanskrit, Arabic, Persian, English antha bhashagalu Indian history, architecture, poetry mattu legal administrative systems na centuries ninda enrich maadiddave. Eighth Schedule multi-linguism celebrate maadutte. Bhasheya mele dvesha cultural richness na curtail maadutte.
english_translation: Languages like Urdu, Sanskrit, Arabic, Persian and English have enriched Indian history, architecture, poetry and legal systems for centuries. The Eighth Schedule celebrates multilingualism. Hatred towards any language curtails our cultural richness.

hate_comment: Ee religious rally nadedre riot aagutte, ban maadi.
counter_speech: Peaceful religious processions freedom of expression mattu religious practice da part. Law and order police surveillance, route permission compliance mattu CCTV monitoring inda maintain aagabeku. Hate slogans athava provocation thadedaaga shanthiyutha celebration saadhya.
english_translation: Peaceful religious processions are part of freedom of expression and religious practice. Law and order must be maintained through police surveillance, route permissions and CCTV monitoring. Curbing hate slogans or provocations ensures peaceful celebrations.

hate_comment: Avara dharma text alli matra violence ide, namma text pure.
counter_speech: Prathiyobba dharmada scriptures metaphorical context, historical setting mattu spiritual allegory olagondirathave. Prathi major faith compassion, forgiveness, truthful living mattu human dignity promote maadutte. Cherry-picking bittu core moral values understand maadona.
english_translation: Every religion's scriptures contain metaphorical contexts, historical settings and spiritual allegories. Every major faith promotes compassion, forgiveness, truthful living and human dignity. Let us understand core moral values rather than cherry-picking verses.

hate_comment: Religious schooling madrassa athava gurukula deshakke dangerous.
counter_speech: Traditional religious education institutions mainstream academic syllabus — science, mathematics, computer education mattu languages — include maadi modernize aagtiro steps thagolthive. Education boards standard oversight maintain maadidre heritage preservation mattu modern employment opportunities eradu saadhya.
english_translation: Traditional religious educational institutions are modernizing by incorporating mainstream academic curricula like science, mathematics, computer education and languages. Standard educational board oversight ensures both heritage preservation and modern employment opportunities.

hate_comment: Avara burial ground namma residential layout hathira irabaaradu.
counter_speech: Dignity in death and proper funeral rites Article 21 constitutional guarantee aagidhe. Municipal urban planning prathiyobba community gu adequate cemeteries mattu crematoriums allocate maadbeku. Civic amenities common planning inda resolve aagabeku, exclusion ninda alla.
english_translation: Dignity in death and proper funeral rites are guaranteed under Article 21 of the constitution. Municipal urban planning must allocate adequate cemeteries and crematoriums for every community. Civic amenities should be resolved through joint planning, not exclusion.

hate_comment: Buddhists peaceful alla, Myanmar nodi reject maadi.
counter_speech: Buddhism Gautam Buddha prabhodhisiro Karuna, Ahimsa mattu Ashtanga Marga aadharada mele jagath prasiddha aagidhe. Specific political conflicts geopolitical factors mele nillathtave, aadare Buddhist spiritual philosophy universal compassion teaching continues aagidhe.
english_translation: Buddhism is globally renowned for Karuna, Ahimsa and the Eightfold Path taught by Gautama Buddha. Specific geopolitical conflicts arise from political factors, but Buddhist spiritual philosophy continues to teach universal compassion.

hate_comment: Tribal rituals adharma, avara customs ban maadabeku.
counter_speech: Adivasi traditions, nature worship, sacred groves preservation mattu indigenous rituals environment conservation ge pristine models aagive. Fifth and Sixth Schedules tribal cultural autonomy protect maadtave. Indigenous cultures na assimilate maado badalu celebrate maadona.
english_translation: Adivasi traditions, nature worship, preservation of sacred groves and indigenous rituals are pristine models of ecological conservation. The Fifth and Sixth Schedules protect tribal cultural autonomy. Let us celebrate indigenous cultures rather than forcing assimilation.

hate_comment: Dharmika trust galu ellaru black money wash maadtiddare.
counter_speech: Income Tax laws mattu Charity Commissioner audits religious trusts finance transparency enforce maadtave. Financial irregularity kandubandre legal forensic audit moolaka action aagabeku. Philanthropic charitable schools, anna daana mattu hospitals nadiso genuine trusts recognize maadbeku.
english_translation: Income Tax laws and Charity Commissioner audits enforce financial transparency in religious trusts. Where financial irregularities emerge, action should be taken through forensic audits. Genuine trusts running charitable schools, food banks and hospitals must be recognized.

hate_comment: Religious symbols public office alli ban aagabeku, fully clean.
counter_speech: Indian secularism equal respect for all faiths (Sarva Dharma Sambhava) tatva adopt maadidhe, Western aggressive secularism alla. Public servants duty discharging nalli neutral aagirabeku, aadhre prathi nagarikana identity dignity respect maadodu namma plural tradition.
english_translation: Indian secularism adopts equal respect for all faiths (Sarva Dharma Sambhava) rather than western aggressive secularism. While public servants must remain neutral in discharging duty, respecting the dignity of every citizen's identity is our plural tradition.

hate_comment: Avara festival sweets thinnabaaradu, unholy.
counter_speech: Habba-haridhinagala sweets hanchikolluvudu namma ooru, keri mattu apartments nalli sneha-sauhardatheya bandhana hechisutte. Food sharing human warmth express maado beautiful tradition. Purity concerns bittu neighbourly warmth celebrate maadona.
english_translation: Sharing sweets during festivals enhances affection and harmony across our towns, neighbourhoods and apartments. Food sharing is a beautiful tradition expressing human warmth. Let us celebrate neighbourly warmth rather than harbouring ungrounded purity concerns.

hate_comment: Parsi jana tumba rich, avara property grab maadona.
counter_speech: Parsi community India da industrialization, science, cancer research research institutes (TIFR, IISc) mattu philanthropic hospitals kattodralli pioneering role play maadiddare. Property grab incitement criminal violation. Avara immense national contribution gauravisi preserve maadona.
english_translation: The Parsi community has played a pioneering role in India's industrialization, sciences, research institutes like TIFR and IISc, and philanthropic hospitals. Inciting property grabbing is a criminal violation. Let us honour and preserve their immense national contribution.

hate_comment: Avara attire nodidre hedarike aagutte, ban maadi.
counter_speech: Religious clothing — turban, hijab, cross, tilak, saffron attire — individual faith identity mattu constitutional liberty da expression. Modern democratic society diverse cultural attires accept maadi peaceful coexistence build maadatte, visual intolerance foster maadalla.
english_translation: Religious clothing — turbans, hijabs, crosses, tilaks, saffron robes — expresses individual faith identity and constitutional liberty. A modern democratic society accommodates diverse cultural attire and builds peaceful coexistence rather than fostering visual intolerance.

hate_comment: Religious conversion ban aagabeku, yaaru change aagbaaradu.
counter_speech: Article 25 freedom of conscience guarantee kodutte, andre prathiyobba individual tanna inner conviction inda faith choose maado hakku haagidhe. Fraud, force athava financial lure prevent maadoke laws iddhave, aadre voluntary spiritual exploration individual liberty da moola lakshana.
