english_translation: Article 25 guarantees freedom of conscience, meaning every individual holds the right to choose their faith out of inner conviction. While laws prevent fraud, force or financial inducements, voluntary spiritual exploration is a hallmark of individual liberty.

hate_comment: Avara religious building destruction aagbeku, historical revenge.
counter_speech: Places of Worship Act 1991 historical monuments status freeze maadi religious harmony preserve maadoke enacted aagidhe. Historical grievances revenge moolaka address maadidre civil strife beleyutte. Rule of law mattu judicial consensus matra shanthi guarantee maadbahudu.
english_translation: The Places of Worship Act 1991 was enacted to freeze the status of religious sites and preserve harmony. Addressing historical grievances through revenge incites civil strife. Only the rule of law and judicial consensus can guarantee peace.

hate_comment: Avara prayers road block maadtiddave, arrest maadi.
counter_speech: Public road usage, traffic management mattu citizen convenience administration regulate maadbeku. Adequate designated prayer grounds provide maadidre road congestion solve aagutte. Civic coordination and dialogue inda solution thagolabahudu, hostility bittu cooperation maadona.
english_translation: Public road usage, traffic management and citizen convenience should be regulated by civic authorities. Providing adequate designated prayer grounds resolves road congestion. Civic coordination and dialogue provide the solution; let us cooperate instead of showing hostility.

hate_comment: Secularism andre minority appeasement ashte.
counter_speech: Secularism prathiyobba citizen gu fundamental equality guarantee maadutte, majority-gu minority-gu samana protection nillatte. Affirmative actions socio-economically backward communities upliftment ge targeted aagirthave. Constitutional balance social justice mattu unity strengthen maadutte.
english_translation: Secularism guarantees fundamental equality to every citizen, providing equal protection to both majority and minority communities. Affirmative action is targeted at uplifting socio-economically marginalized groups. Constitutional balance strengthens social justice and unity.

hate_comment: Religious charity kevala avara community ge matra hogutte.
counter_speech: Disaster relief, flood rescue, community kitchens mattu eye camps antha emergency situations nalli religious organizations religion nodade ellarigu unconditional help extend maadiddave. Humanitarian compassion faith boundaries meeri human brotherhood express maadutte.
english_translation: During emergencies like disaster relief, flood rescues, community kitchens and eye camps, religious organizations have extended unconditional help to everyone regardless of faith. Humanitarian compassion crosses faith boundaries to express human brotherhood.

hate_comment: Interfaith dialogue waste of time, differences solve aagalla.
counter_speech: Interfaith councils misconceptions dispel maadoke, local flashpoints de-escalate maadoke mattu communal harmony maintain maadoke proven platforms. Dialogue misunderstandings remove maadi trust build maadutte. Samvaada civil peace build maado most potent tool.
english_translation: Interfaith councils are proven platforms to dispel misconceptions, de-escalate local flashpoints and maintain communal harmony. Dialogue removes misunderstandings and builds trust. Discussion is the most potent tool for building civil peace.

hate_comment: Avara god real alla, namma god matra truth.
counter_speech: Different spiritual traditions truth reach maadalu diverse paths describe maadtave — Rig Veda 'Ekam Sat Vipra Bahudha Vadanti' heLuvanthe. Religious humility mattu respect anuvadhu spiritual maturity da sign. Theological debate mutual respect foundation mele irabeku.
english_translation: Different spiritual traditions describe diverse paths to reach the truth — as the Rig Veda states, 'Ekam Sat Vipra Bahudha Vadanti'. Religious humility and respect are marks of spiritual maturity. Theological discussions must rest on mutual respect.

hate_comment: Avara scriptural study scientific temper ge opposite.
counter_speech: Historical scientific discoveries — astronomy, algebra, medicine, optics — religious scholars deep contemplation indane emerge aagidhe. Scientific temper empirical questioning nourish maadutte, spirituality ethical morality guide maadutte. Eradu different spheres of knowledge aagive.
english_translation: Historical scientific discoveries in astronomy, algebra, medicine and optics emerged from deep contemplation by scholars of various faiths. Scientific temper nourishes empirical questioning, while spirituality guides ethical morality. They are different spheres of knowledge.

hate_comment: Avara festivals nalli hygiene iralla, unhygienic.
counter_speech: Public gatherings and festivals nalli municipal cleanliness, waste management mattu sanitation civic authorities responsibility aagidhe. Swachh Bharat principles prathi religious gathering gu apply aagutte. Citizen awareness volunteers clean-up drives moolaka hygiene ensure maadabahudu.
english_translation: Municipal cleanliness, waste management and sanitation during public gatherings and festivals are civic authorities' responsibilities. Swachh Bharat principles apply to all religious gatherings. Citizen volunteers can ensure hygiene through clean-up drives.

hate_comment: Avara religious songs radio TV alli play aagbaardu.
counter_speech: Prasar Bharati mattu national broadcasting platforms devotional music of all faiths broadcast maadi cultural unity enhance maadtave. Sufi music, Bhakti geetegalu, Gregorian chants, Shabad Kirtan namma collective musical wealth. Diversity broadcast maadodhu pluralism strengthen maadutte.
english_translation: Prasar Bharati and national broadcasting platforms enhance cultural unity by broadcasting devotional music of all faiths. Sufi music, Bhakti poetry, Gregorian chants and Shabad Kirtan are our collective musical wealth. Broadcasting diversity strengthens pluralism.

hate_comment: Religious personal laws civil rights na crush maadtave.
counter_speech: Personal laws gender equality mattu constitutional fundamental rights parameters olagade progressive judicial interpretations moolaka reform aagtha bandhive. Gender justice protect maadoke constructive law commission debates nadibeku, hostility bittu reform foster maadona.
english_translation: Personal laws have been progressively reformed through judicial interpretations within constitutional fundamental rights and gender equality parameters. Constructive law commission debates should proceed to protect gender justice, fostering reform rather than hostility.

hate_comment: Avara community houses ge rent kodabeda, trouble thartare.
counter_speech: Rental housing discrimination religion athava community nodi maaduvudu civil rights violation mattu unfair practice. Tenant verification police verification protocols prakaara transparent aagi follow maadbahudu. Stereotyping bittu lawful leasing agreements observe maadona.
english_translation: Denying rental housing based on religion or community is a violation of civil rights and an unfair practice. Tenant verification can be transparently followed via standard police protocols. Let us observe lawful leasing agreements rather than stereotyping.

hate_comment: Avara holy place nalli bomb manufacture maadtare.
counter_speech: Baseless rumours public trust undermine maadi communal tension ignite maadoke spread maadtaare. Intelligence agencies mattu state police strict surveillance maintain maadtaare. Misinformation circulate maadodhu legal offense, verified institutional statements matra nambona.
english_translation: Baseless rumours are spread to undermine public trust and ignite communal tensions. Intelligence agencies and state police maintain strict surveillance. Circulating misinformation is a legal offence; let us rely solely on verified institutional statements.

hate_comment: Avara dharma holidays govt cancel maadbeku, waste.
counter_speech: National and gazetted holidays all major religious traditions celebrate maadoke provision maadtave, adhu harmonious inclusive governance reflect maadutte. Public diversity honor maado holidays mutual cultural understanding mattu economic resting periods expand maadtave.
english_translation: National and gazetted holidays provide for celebrating all major religious traditions, reflecting harmonious, inclusive governance. Holidays honouring public diversity expand mutual cultural understanding and needed economic rest.

hate_comment: Religious leaders speech ellaru hate spread maadtare.
counter_speech: Anekha religious leaders compassion, communal peace, de-addiction counseling mattu charity inspire maadtaare. Hate speech circulate maadovara viruddha IPC/BNS strict legal provisions irathtave. Legal enforcement hate speech punish maadatte, aadre ethical spiritual guidance appreciate maadbeku.
english_translation: Many religious leaders inspire compassion, communal peace, de-addiction counselling and charity. Strict legal provisions under the penal code exist against those circulating hate speech. The law punishes hate speech, but ethical spiritual guidance should be appreciated.

hate_comment: Avara religious literature school syllabus alli tharodu beda.
counter_speech: Comparative literature, Bhakti poetry, Sufi philosophy mattu ethical fables schools nalli multi-cultural empathy belasoke introduce maadtaare. Universal moral values shanthi, satya mattu daya understand maadalu ethical stories help maadtave, indoctrination alla.
english_translation: Comparative literature, Bhakti poetry, Sufi philosophy and ethical fables are introduced in schools to nurture multicultural empathy. Ethical stories help students understand universal moral values like peace, truth and kindness, not indoctrination.

hate_comment: Avara places of worship underground funding inda operate aagutte.
counter_speech: Religious institutions banking channels, FCRA approvals mattu audited financial balance sheets moolaka compliance maintain maadtave. Financial irregularity allegations Ministry of Home Affairs mattu tax authorities investigate maadtaare. Gossip spread maadodakinta institutional audits check maadona.
english_translation: Religious institutions maintain compliance through banking channels, FCRA clearances and audited balance sheets. Allegations of financial irregularities are investigated by the Ministry of Home Affairs and tax authorities. Let us check institutional audits rather than spreading gossip.

hate_comment: Avara community funeral sound disturb maadutte, stop maadi.
counter_speech: Funeral rituals mourning families ge grief process maadoke emotionally critical tradition. Decency, solemn silence mattu civil accommodation grieving families gauravisuvudhu basic human etiquette aagidhe. Bereaved families sympathy mathu dignity deserve maadtaare.
english_translation: Funeral rituals are emotionally critical traditions that help grieving families process their loss. Decency, solemn silence and civil accommodation honoring grieving families are basic human etiquette. Bereaved families deserve sympathy and dignity.

hate_comment: Avara community students ge scholarships bandh maadi.
counter_speech: Merit-cum-means scholarships economically underprivileged students higher education retain maadoke empower maadtave. Educational equity literacy rate improve maadi overall national human capital elevate maadutte. Equal opportunity deshada inclusive economic development ge fuel aagutte.
english_translation: Merit-cum-means scholarships empower economically underprivileged students to retain higher education. Educational equity improves literacy and elevates overall national human capital. Equal opportunity fuels inclusive national economic development.

hate_comment: Avara tradition dance namma tradition ge shock tharutte.
counter_speech: India da performing arts diverse folk, classical mattu spiritual dance idioms olagondive — Yakshagana, Kathak, Sufi Whirling, Theyyam. Diverse aesthetic forms cultural imagination broaden maadtave. Cultural open-mindedness namma artistic tradition da pride.
english_translation: India's performing arts comprise diverse folk, classical and spiritual dance idioms like Yakshagana, Kathak, Sufi Whirling and Theyyam. Diverse aesthetic forms broaden cultural imagination. Cultural open-mindedness is the pride of our artistic tradition.

hate_comment: Religious places tourist visit restrict maadona, only believers.
counter_speech: Hampi, Belur-Halebidu, Ajmer Sharif, Golden Temple, Velankanni antha world-famous sacred sites heritage tourism, historical inquiry mattu universal fellowship promote maadtave. Heritage sites shared human history reflect maadtave, respectful visitors celebrate maadbahudu.
english_translation: World-famous sacred sites like Hampi, Belur-Halebidu, Ajmer Sharif, the Golden Temple and Velankanni promote heritage tourism, historical inquiry and universal fellowship. Heritage sites reflect shared human history and welcome respectful visitors.

hate_comment: Avara community festivals national holidays list inda thegi.
counter_speech: Gazetted public holidays namma multi-cultural identity institutional recognition aagidhe. Diversity acknowledge maadi respect kododhu composite nationalism strengthen maadutte. Major celebrations all citizens participate maado shared social joy aagiratte.
english_translation: Gazetted public holidays are institutional recognition of our multicultural identity. Acknowledging diversity with respect strengthens composite nationalism. Major celebrations provide shared social joy where all citizens can participate.

hate_comment: Religious flags public place nalli ban aagabeku.
counter_speech: Public celebrations time nalli municipal guidelines and police permits prakaara temporary decorative flags display maaduvudu conventional practice. Public nuisance athava obstruction thadedaaga shanthiyutha festive display celebrate aagutte. Civil balance safety ensure maadutte.
english_translation: Displaying temporary decorative flags during festivities in accordance with municipal guidelines and police permits is conventional practice. Preventing public nuisance or obstruction ensures festive displays remain peaceful. Civil balance preserves public safety.

hate_comment: Avara religious traditions backward, modern science mundhe waste.
counter_speech: Spiritual traditions ethical values, mindfulness, compassion mattu community solidarity provide maadtave, scientific inquiry material technology advance maadutte. Eradu different aspects of human progress aagidhe. Science mattu philosophical contemplation mutual respect inda enrich aagtave.
english_translation: Spiritual traditions provide ethical values, mindfulness, compassion and community solidarity, while scientific inquiry advances material technology. Both are complementary aspects of human progress. Science and philosophical contemplation enrich each other with mutual respect.

hate_comment: Ninna dharma nanna dharma-ge hinda chikka, ninna beliefs correct alla.
counter_speech: Dharma anuvadhu vyaktiya aathma-shuddhi, karune mattu jeevana maargada nambike. Yaava dharmavu chikkadhu athava doddadhu antha compare maadi hinsege prachodhane maadodhu thappu. Prathi dharmadalli shanthi mattu manavatheya sandesha ide, adannu gauravisi ondaagi baalona.
english_translation: Religion is an individual's path of inner purification, compassion and belief. Comparing faiths to label one inferior or superior and inciting discord is wrong. Every religion carries a message of peace and humanity; let us respect that and live together in harmony.

hate_comment: Bere rajyadavaru namma Bengaluru ge bandu namma kelsa kadiyuttare.
counter_speech: Bengaluru global innovation hub aagi beliyalu diverse talent pool, entrepreneurship mattu investment kaarana. Article 19(1)(e) prakaara all Indian citizens gu deshadalli yavude kade kelsa maaduva samvidhanika hakku ide. Local youth skill training improve maadidre competition nalli mundhirtivi.
english_translation: Bengaluru grew into a global innovation hub due to a diverse talent pool, entrepreneurship and investment. Under Article 19(1)(e), all Indian citizens hold the constitutional right to work anywhere in the country. Upskilling local youth ensures we stay ahead in competition.

hate_comment: Ee rajyadavaru Kannada kaliyalla, avarannu illinda odisi.
counter_speech: Kannada bhasha namma abhimana mattu identity. Hosa janarige hostile threats haakodara badalu preethi inda Kannada kalisuvudhu, beginner learning workshops organize maaduvudu mattu cultural exchange encourage maaduvudu Kannada bhasha premada nijavada swabhaava aagidhe.
english_translation: Kannada is our pride and identity. Instead of issuing hostile threats to new arrivals, teaching Kannada with affection, organizing beginner workshops and encouraging cultural exchange reflect the true spirit of love for Kannada.

hate_comment: North Indians ellaru arrogant, avarige south culture gottilla.
counter_speech: Regional stereotypes ninda regional animosity mathra beliyutte. India vividha rajyagala rich cultural traditions inda koodidhe. South Indian art, architecture, music mattu literature open dialogue moolaka share maadidre mutual understanding mattu cultural respect deepen aagutte.
english_translation: Regional stereotypes only breed regional animosity. India is made up of rich cultural traditions across diverse states. Sharing South Indian art, architecture, music and literature through open dialogue deepens mutual understanding and cultural respect.

hate_comment: South Indians ge Hindi baralla, avaru Indian e alla.
counter_speech: Indian citizenship yaavude ondhu bhashaya mele nirdhaaravagalla. Samvidhana Eighth Schedule nalli 22 official languages recognize maadidhe, Kannada kooda classical language status haadide. Multi-lingual federalism deshadha aikyatheya moola shakti aagidhe.
english_translation: Indian citizenship is not determined by any single language. The constitution recognizes 22 official languages in the Eighth Schedule, and Kannada holds classical language status. Multilingual federalism is the core strength of our nation's unity.

hate_comment: Ee state border alli thondare maadtare, border close maadi.
counter_speech: Inter-state border disputes constitutional tribunals, Supreme Court rulings mattu inter-state council dialogues moolaka resolve aagabeku. Borders block maadidre essential commodities supply chain collapse aagutte mattu innocent common citizens suffer aagtaare. Legal dialogue proper path.
english_translation: Inter-state border disputes must be resolved through constitutional tribunals, Supreme Court rulings and Inter-State Council dialogues. Blocking borders collapses essential commodity supply chains and hurts innocent citizens. Legal dialogue is the proper path.

hate_comment: Bere deshadinda bandiro refugees ellaru terrorists, shoo maadi.
counter_speech: Refugees war, persecution mattu humanitarian crises inda prana ulisikolloke bandavaru. National security agencies strict biometric verification mattu background checks conduct maadtave. Humanitarian compassion mattu border security balance maaduvudhu international humanitarian standards mandate aagidhe.
english_translation: Refugees arrive seeking to save their lives from war, persecution and humanitarian crises. National security agencies conduct strict biometric verification and background checks. Balancing humanitarian compassion with border security complies with international humanitarian standards.

hate_comment: Namma Cauvery neeru bere rajyakke hani kooda kodabaaradu.
counter_speech: Cauvery river water sharing riparian rights, monsoon variations mattu Supreme Court guidelines aadharada mele Cauvery Water Management Authority regulate maadutte. Farmer distress solve maadalu scientific water conservation, drip irrigation mattu distress-sharing formula effective aagutte.
english_translation: Cauvery water sharing is regulated by the Cauvery Water Management Authority based on riparian rights, monsoon variations and Supreme Court directives. Scientific water conservation, drip irrigation and distress-sharing formulas effectively resolve farmer distress.

hate_comment: Northeast jana Indians thara kanalla, avarannu foreigners antha heli.
counter_speech: Northeast India da nagarikaru namma deshadha integral bhaga. Avara sports achievements, rich music, biodiversity preservation mattu military service deshakke immense pride thandhidhe. Appearance mele racial slurs use maadodhu criminal offence mattu national integration ge droha.
english_translation: Citizens of Northeast India are an integral part of our nation. Their sporting achievements, rich music, biodiversity preservation and military service bring immense pride to the country. Racial slurs based on appearance are criminal offences and betray national integration.

hate_comment: Kashmir janarige yaavude rights kodabaaradu, force matra beku.
counter_speech: Sustainable peace local democratic engagement, educational opportunities, tourism infrastructure development mattu youth employment moolaka build aagutte. Citizen rights mattu safety ensure maaduvudhu constitutional governance da priority. Shanthiyutha samvaada ground integration ge permanent solution.
english_translation: Sustainable peace is built through local democratic engagement, educational opportunities, tourism infrastructure and youth employment. Ensuring citizen rights and safety is the priority of constitutional governance. Peaceful dialogue is the permanent solution for integration.

hate_comment: Foreign tourists namma culture spoil maadtare, entry ban maadi.
counter_speech: International tourism foreign exchange earnings, local artisans livelihood, hospitality jobs mattu cultural exchange expand maadutte. Cultural etiquette and civic regulations preserve maadalu proper orientation signage beku. Responsible tourism economy na strengthen maadutte.
english_translation: International tourism expands foreign exchange earnings, local artisans' livelihoods, hospitality jobs and cultural exchange. Clear orientation signage preserves cultural etiquette and civic regulations. Responsible tourism strengthens our economy.

hate_comment: Migrant laborers namma ooru dirty maadtiddare, odisi.
counter_speech: Construction, metro projects, roads mattu industrial development nalli migrant workers relentless physical labor contribution amoolyavada aagidhe. Municipal administration worker residential camps nalli proper sanitation, drinking water mattu waste bins provide maadi cleanliness ensure maadbeku.
english_translation: The physical contribution of migrant workers in construction, metro projects, roads and industrial development is invaluable. Municipal authorities must provide proper sanitation, drinking water and waste bins in worker settlements to ensure cleanliness.

hate_comment: Bere rajyada vidyarthigalige namma university alli seat kodabaaradu.
counter_speech: Higher educational institutions pan-India entrance examinations and academic merit aadharada mele open aagirthave. Diverse student cohorts exchange of ideas, research quality mattu competitive exposure enhance maadtave. Meritocracy national excellence ge foundational.

hate_comment: Western culture fully poison, reject all modern habits.

english_translation: Modern global progress encompasses scientific inquiry, constitutional democracy, universal human rights and technological innovations. Preserving our indigenous ethical values while adopting universal scientific innovations is the pragmatic approach.

english_translation: Learning foreign languages opens career pathways in global diplomatic representation, multinational trade negotiations and cross-border scientific collaboration. Multilingual skills enhance the global competitiveness of our nation's human capital.

english_translation: Learning Kannada demands time and practice. Creating beginner modules, supportive language circles and a helpful learning environment in workplaces is the positive approach. When taught with warmth, everyone embraces the language.

hate_comment: Island territories India ge burden, discard maadi.

english_translation: The Andaman & Nicobar and Lakshadweep islands are priceless strategic assets for India's Exclusive Economic Zone, maritime security and Indo-Pacific presence. Preserving island ecology while boosting the sustainable blue economy is vital.

english_translation: State cultural emblems, the state anthem and regional flags are legitimate expressions of federal pride that fully acknowledge the supremacy of the national tricolour. Cultural symbolism cherishes the spirit of federal democracy.

english_translation: Damaging vehicles causes severe losses to daily commuters, truck drivers carrying food grain supplies and public property. Vandalism is a criminal offence. Border issues must be addressed through bilateral administrative channels and Supreme Court hearings.

hate_comment: Outstation students namma colleges alli cultural festivals celebrate maadbaardu.

english_translation: College campuses are spaces that foster diversity, open exchange of cultural art forms and pan-Indian unity. Celebrating diverse regional festivals enables inter-state friendship and mutual cultural appreciation to flourish.

english_translation: Diplomatic disagreements are handled through formal demarches, press statements and strategic communication by the Ministry of External Affairs. Diplomatic protocols are the standard institutional pathway to manage bilateral relationships with maturity.

Millions of common travelers, patients travelling for surgeries mattu essential commodities railways rely maadtaare. Public infrastructure protection namma shared civic duty.
english_translation: Railway lines are the lifeline of national infrastructure, and inciting damage to them is an anti-social criminal act. Millions of common travellers, patients travelling for surgery and essential goods rely on railways. Protecting public infrastructure is our shared civic duty.

hate_comment: International environmental treaties reject maadi, develop at any cost.

Sustainable development renewable energy transition mattu economic progress na balance maaduvudhu future generations ge mandatory.
english_translation: Environmental agreements provide the necessary framework to combat global climate change, groundwater depletion, air pollution and biodiversity loss. Balancing sustainable development and renewable energy with economic progress is mandatory for future generations.

hate_comment: Border districts school nalli neighbouring state language teach maadbedi.

english_translation: Border regions historically nurture bilingual communities naturally. Protecting linguistic minorities is a constitutional mandate under Article 350A. Multilingual education elevates harmonious border trade and social cohesion.

hate_comment: Foreign tech companies national security ge leak, ban maadi.

english_translation: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, local server hosting regulations and cybersecurity audits strictly enforce digital compliance. Strategic regulation guarantees data sovereignty while foreign investment helps upgrade tech ecosystems.

english_translation: Commercial driving licenses are issued upon passing Motor Vehicles Act statutory guidelines. Every licensed driver who adheres to rules, meter fares and passenger safety standards holds the right to earn a lawful livelihood.

hate_comment: Defence agreements with other nations slavery, reject all pacts.
counter_speech: Strategic bilateral defense pacts intelligence sharing, counter-terrorism interoperability, maritime surveillance mattu technology transfer strengthen maadtave. Strategic autonomy namma foreign policy anchor aagidhu, partnerships national interests enhance maadtave.
english_translation: Strategic bilateral defence pacts strengthen intelligence sharing, counter-terrorism interoperability, maritime surveillance and technology transfer. Strategic autonomy anchors our foreign policy while partnerships enhance national security.

Archaeological Survey of India rigorous historical conservation principles follow maadutte. Historical continuity understanding educate maadutte, vandalism alla.
english_translation: Historical monument architecture reflects complex historical eras, layered civilizational encounters and artistic influences. The Archaeological Survey of India follows rigorous conservation principles. Understanding historical continuity educates, whereas vandalism destroys.

english_translation: The Inter-State River Water Disputes Act 1956 established legal tribunal frameworks. Internal water disputes must be resolved through judicial arbitration, scientific hydrological mapping and basin water management. Violent threats dissolve national unity.

hate_comment: Immigrant children ge govt schools entry restrict maadi.
counter_speech: Right to Education (RTE) Act Article 21A 6 inda 14 years age group na prathiyobba maguvigu free and compulsory schooling guarantee kodutte. Child education human rights responsibility aagidhu, child literacy crime prevention mattu civilized society ge foundational.
english_translation: The Right to Education (RTE) Act under Article 21A guarantees free and compulsory schooling to every child between ages 6 and 14. Child education is a human rights responsibility; child literacy is foundational for crime prevention and a civilized society.

hate_comment: Foreign media journalists coverage ban maadi, biased reporting.

english_translation: Press accreditation, visa guidelines and journalistic ethics compliance are standard institutional frameworks. To counter biased reporting, holding factual press conferences, disseminating transparent data and robust public diplomacy are credible strategies.

english_translation: Under the One Nation One Tax principle, National Permits and FASTag electronic toll systems have streamlined interstate movement of goods and passengers. Arbitrary harassment inflates interstate trade costs and burdens consumers. Let us ensure transparent logistics.

hate_comment: International student exchange programs deshakke threat, stop maadi.

english_translation: Academic exchange programs enrich university rankings, global research collaborations, patent filings and bilateral soft-power diplomacy. Verified academic exchanges benchmark our national talent against global standards.

english_translation: National raw material distribution operates under federal frameworks like the Mines and Minerals Act. Interdependent supply chains in steel, coal, power and cement are necessary to build national infrastructure. Economic federalism powers collective growth.

hate_comment: Ee foreign country tourists namma sanskruti padu maadtaare, ban maadi.

english_translation: Tourism revenue funds heritage conservation, local artisan economies and archaeological site maintenance. Cultural etiquette brochures and certified guides are effective tools to educate foreign visitors on local customs.

hate_comment: Kalla sikkidre road alli hodidu bidbeku, police ge kododu waste.

english_translation: Mob lynching or physical assault on the street is a criminal offence and illegal violence. There is a grave danger of innocent people being harmed on mere suspicion. Surrendering the suspect directly to police and seeking justice through legal prosecution is the civilized path.

hate_comment: Hendati ge hodedre saripaduttade, avalu kelsa sari maadilla andre.

english_translation: Domestic violence is a punishable criminal offence under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act. Family disagreements must be resolved peacefully through open communication, professional marital counselling or elders' mediation. Violence is never a solution.

hate_comment: Ee hudga ragging maadidare, ivanige hodyodu bidbeku, avarige paatha kalsbeku.

english_translation: Ragging is strictly prohibited and an offence under UGC regulations and Supreme Court directives. Rather than taking physical retaliation, filing a formal complaint with the college Anti-Ragging Committee for disciplinary suspension and legal action is the correct procedure.

hate_comment: Ee neta ge hodedu saakidare namma ge shaanti sigutte.
counter_speech: Political leaders mele physical violence assault charges mattu severe penal action attract maadutte. Prajaprabhutvadalli ballot paper, peaceful public petitions mattu judicial accountability namma shreshta ayudhagalu. Hinse anuvadhu political reform tharalla, anarchy tharuthe.
english_translation: Physical violence against political leaders attracts assault charges and severe penal action. In a democracy, the ballot paper, peaceful public petitions and judicial accountability are our finest tools. Violence brings anarchy rather than political reform.

hate_comment: Ee dharmada janarannu baLisi haakbeku, avarannu halli inda hodibidbeku.

english_translation: Inciting violence against a community is a non-bailable criminal provocation under the penal code. Coexisting in harmony across all communities in our villages and towns is the foundation of peace. Let us reject communal hatred through legal action and preserve harmony.

hate_comment: Jagalakke hodidre hodi, ond gandu ge ond gandu.

english_translation: Street fights and physical clashes lead to severe bodily injuries, permanent police records and ruined careers. Self-control, emotional regulation and verbal de-escalation are the hallmarks of real strength. Managing temper and opting for mediation is the mature approach.

hate_comment: Ee bullies ge hodedare mathe baralla, ive paatha.

english_translation: Using violence to counter bullying only fuels a cycle of escalation. Taking institutional action through school authorities, campus counsellors and disciplinary boards is effective. Systematic reporting establishes accountability for bullies, not physical assault.

hate_comment: Pak ge hogi ond yuddha maadi, ellaru satti bidli.

International diplomacy, tactical deterrence mattu cross-border security measures national interest protect maadtave. Jingoistic violence slogans kinta strategic security planning deshakke balavaadhadhu.
english_translation: War brings the loss of millions of human lives, economic destruction, widowhood and intergenerational devastation. International diplomacy, tactical deterrence and cross-border security measures protect national interests. Strategic security planning strengthens the nation more than jingoistic violent slogans.

hate_comment: Ee kaalejinalli yaaradru hudugi ge tondare koDidre kai muriyabeku.

english_translation: Harassment or eve-teasing is a constitutional offence, and swift legal action should be ensured through the institutional Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) and police women protection cells. Strong legal punishment creates deterrence for perpetrators rather than vigilante justice.

hate_comment: Prani galannu kutte hodedu hodi, avu tondare.

english_translation: Cruelty or poisoning of stray animals is a punishable offence under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act. Managing street animals must be handled humanely through municipal animal birth control (ABC), anti-rabies vaccination and shelters. Compassion is the root of humanity.

hate_comment: Ee boys ge nannu pagale tindre tooga bekku, hodedu hodi.

english_translation: Invoking physical violence when encountering verbal teasing or disagreements violates penal laws. Establishing cool-headed verbal boundaries, walking away from the situation or requesting security intervention preserves personal dignity.

hate_comment: Ee rapist ge sannuvu kodabeku, kaanoonu bekilla.

english_translation: For heinous sexual crimes, strict criminal prosecution, fast-track special courts and stringent statutory penalties exist in the law. Due process of law is mandatory to avoid wrongful convictions. The rule of law alone guarantees civilized constitutional justice.

hate_comment: Ee Muslim hudugana hodidare, namma ge shaanti.

english_translation: Assaulting an individual based on their religious identity is a severe hate crime and destroys the social fabric. Our Indian society stands on brotherhood and the rule of law. Violent incitement attracts police action; let us preserve peaceful harmony.

hate_comment: Ee shikshaka ge bidabaaradu, makkalannu hodedaru.

english_translation: Corporal punishment is strictly illegal under Section 17 of the RTE Act. Rather than violent retaliation, submitting a formal complaint to the school management committee and the Block Education Officer is proper. Institutional accountability legally rectifies teacher misconduct.

hate_comment: Ee sullu suddi haakidavara mele hodedu hodi.

Physical assault criminal offense aagidhe, aadare verified counter-information mattu digital reporting fake news ecosystem na legally neutralize maadutte.
english_translation: Circulating fake news is a cybercrime offence that should be debunked via fact-checking portals and reported to cyber police cells. Physical assault is a criminal offence, whereas verified counter-information and digital reporting legally neutralize fake news.

hate_comment: Ee naaygalige vishaa haakidre ond kasta kadime.

Dog bite concerns address maadalu municipal sterilization, rabies vaccination mattu civic animal feeding guidelines implement maaduvudhu lawful approach aagidhe.
english_translation: Poisoning stray dogs is punishable criminal brutality under Supreme Court guidelines and the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act. Addressing dog-bite concerns by implementing municipal sterilization, rabies vaccination and designated feeding zones is the lawful approach.

hate_comment: Nanna ge kopa baro, hodedu hodiyuvudu ond ge saripaadu.

english_translation: While anger is a natural emotion, expressing it through physical assault results in criminal charges and remorse. Anger management techniques, deep breathing or professional counselling help channel anger productively. Peaceful resolution protects dignity.

hate_comment: Ee gundaagalige hodi, avaru ellaru goonda galu.

Citizens information police emergency numbers ge report maadbeku. Private vigilantism chaos create maadutte, institutional policing law enforce maadutte.
english_translation: State police intelligence, preventive detentions and organized crime task forces hold legal authority to neutralize antisocial elements. Citizens should report information through police emergency channels. Private vigilantism creates chaos, while institutional policing enforces the law.
